julia: Hey finance, Sentra (cust SENTRA-58) reported they were charged again after an auto-refund for a failed invoice. They say net extra charge $320. Can someone investigate?
omar: Pulling transactions now. Looks like refund cr_1Laa... issued 2026-03-05 then dispute workflow TTL reversed it on 2026-03-06 and the system re-charged the invoice incrementally. Two charge lines for same usage_id.
omar: Tx log snippet:
```
txn_id,kind,amount,ts,meta
ch_9a7x,charge,800.00,2026-03-04,invoice=INV-2026-0422
cr_1Laa,refund,-800.00,2026-03-05,ref=INV-2026-0422
rev_3Qz1,refund_reversal,800.00,2026-03-06,reason=dispute_ttl
ch_9a7x-dup,charge,320.00,2026-03-06,meta=auto_retry
```
omar: Net impact to customer = +320.00 unintended. Looks like our retry logic double-applied partial charge after reversal.
julia: Oof. Customer is asking for a manual correction + note on invoice PDF.
tara: Elaine can approve up to $500 for platform errors; tagging @elaine for sign-off.
elaine: Approved :white_check_mark: Please label as "goodwill: refund_rollback" and include dispute id DIS-2026-77 in the ledger note.
omar: Creating manual credit now:
```
# create manual credit to correct refund rollback
billingctl credit --customer SENTRA-58 --invoice INV-2026-0422 --amount 320.00 --currency USD --reason "goodwill: refund_rollback" --note "DIS-2026-77"
```
acct-bot: Credit created: cr_1MZ0pVt, amount $320.00, status: pending.
omar: Posted ledger entry REF-2026-197 and flagged ENG ticket ENG-4021 to disable auto_retry on refund reversals.
julia: I'll send the customer a short apology + corrected invoice PDF and confirm when they see the credit.
elaine: Added to March manual adjustments file. Thanks for the quick fix. :thumbsup:
